summary: Phase 21 Homework module end-to-end validation on LPGS (live) + sandbox pytest. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase21_live.py (14 live tests, all pass) and re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_phase21.py (6/6 pass). Validated the full acceptance loop: subject-teacher (prasad27) creates Grade 8-A Mathematics homework; unrelated teachers (manoj HS, sreeja LP) get 403 on create; student (g8student) sees + submits a file+note; teacher inbox lists the submission (manoj gets 403 on inbox); redo requires feedback (400 without); redo-with-feedback flips status, student resubmit bumps version>=2 and status returns to submitted; teacher verify succeeds; close+reopen works and close blocks student submit with 400; homework-stats returns assigned/submitted/verified; bell /api/notifications fan-out contains homework entries for both student and teacher. Frontend verified end-to-end: teacher Homework page loads (data-testid teacher-homework-page), create dialog opens, class/section/subject dropdown lists prasad's assigned (class_name section subject) tuples, title+due inputs work, Create homework returns toast + card appears, Submissions modal lists submissions with Pending roster, Close/Reopen toggles state. Student /portal → Homework tab correctly scoped (only Grade 8-A homework shown; the Grade 10 UI-test HW did NOT appear for g8student — scope OK), status badge reflects server state (SUBMITTED / VERIFIED).

minor.issue: Response is {message, late} only — does not return the submission id/version. Live UI/clients that chain actions must GET /submissions after submit to resolve id. Consider returning the full submission object (id, version, status, late).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. The native <select> option content is wrapped in a <span data-ve-dynamic> by the dev tooling, triggering a console error on every render. Not functionally broken but noisy and could be a real hydration bug in production builds.

issues: Due-date field uses the native browser datetime-local picker (<input type="datetime-local">) instead of the shadcn date picker used elsewhere — inconsistent look across the app (same pattern flagged in iteration_13).

action_items: Return the created submission object (id, version, status, late) from POST /api/homework/{id}/submit so clients don't have to re-fetch the inbox.
Fix the <option><span> hydration warning in TeacherHomework.jsx CreateDialog (either render plain text or move the span out of the <option>).
Consider replacing the native datetime-local due-date input with the shadcn date-time picker for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Permission model is correctly enforced: _teaches_subject checks teacher_assignments for exact class+subject (section-specific or whole-class blank-section). Class-teacher-of-section without subject assignment is correctly denied (verified live with sreeja/manoj).
delete_homework returns 409 when any submission exists — verified live (TEST_HW_P21_* with submissions could not be deleted).
Attachment constraints (<=10MB, <=5 files, pdf/jpg/png/webp/doc/docx) are enforced in HW_ATTACH_TYPES/HW_MAX_* — covered by sandbox test_phase21.py.
Notifications: _notify fan-out to class+section students and linked parents on new HW and to assigning teacher on submission is working (bell shows homework entries live).

server.py is now 6451 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Please split into routers (homework, portal, teacher, admin, principal, timetable, marks, auth) — this has been flagged for several iterations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (create, inbox modal, close/reopen reflect, student portal scope, submitted badge). Minor hydration warning and inconsistent date picker remain.

test_credentials: LPGS: prasad27@lpgs.com/teach123 (G8 Math + G10 Math teacher); manoj@lpgs.com/teach123 and sreeja@lpgs.com/teach123 (unrelated teachers for 403 tests); g8student@lpgs.com/student123; admin@lpgs.com/admin123.
seed_data_creation: Created on LPGS (not fully reversible): 2 Grade 8-A Mathematics homework rows (TEST_HW_P21_1791214024 and TEST_HW_P21_1791214052) that could not be deleted because they received submissions during the test loop — both are now status=closed (reopen flow tested on the second one which is now open/closed? verified via verify_final then close+reopen). The Grade 10 UI-test homework (TEST_UI_HW_1791214084) with no submissions was deleted after testing. Submissions for the student (g8student) remain and will show as part of their homework history — acceptable per review_request note allowing Grade 8 Maths homework creation on LPGS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_phase21_live.py -n 0 -v` for a full live regression of the Phase 21 loop (prasad/manoj/sreeja/g8student/admin on LPGS). The suite is idempotent on creation but leaves 1 TEST_HW_P21_close_* HW per run (open) plus one submission on the main TEST_HW. If HWs accumulate, the teacher inbox will have many 'TEST_' rows; purge via platform tool or add a sweep at the end of the test. test_phase21.py uses a throwaway Mongo DB and is unaffected by live state.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Minor action items only: enrich /submit response payload and clean the <option><span> hydration warning. Both are low-impact and already called out in action_items.
